title: Heavy, heavy-extended and cryogenic barrel ADS spread factors

finding.sourceMapping: Each exact weapon/barrel selector GUID is joined to its GS-bound GBM_Increase_ADS_* object. The descriptor-derived operands are under Class_5e5631ff/Field_6b84de87/{Field_447d6d51,Field_0a160c57}/{Field_0084b1d1,Field_2ca8533e,Field_1b9eef5d,Field_4d3f0635}/{Field_5695ee1c,Field_98a799ba}.
finding.rawProof: For all 61 exact weapon/barrel choices, both ADS branches and all four site fields match current XML, decoded EBX and descriptor-derived raw bytes; numeric comparison allows 1e-6 float rounding.
finding.remainingUncertainty: The exact GS selector edge, owner collection, and GBM operands are verified. Native effect priority/composition and the Analyzer's runtime equivalence to the game remain unproven.
finding.neutralDefaults: The other site barrel adsSpreadIncMult=1 entries have no selector-bound GBM_Increase_ADS object in the reviewed current GS classes. They remain identity software defaults; this does not prove native absence.

limits: Site values are shared by attachment family; per-weapon selected selector edges and source objects are retained in the detail JSONL.
GS XML is configured source composition evidence. This audit makes no runtime proof claim.
